_comment: Copy to sources.json (gitignored) and describe your own sources there. One entry per stream: its page at /<slug> and its listener. listed=false keeps a source off the landing page (reachable by URL, noindex). listener.input is a URL or a file on the server; local_input overrides it for scripts/dev.sh. Ports must be unique. listener.mode (continuous | on-demand) and listener.idle_after (e.g. 30s, 2m) override the node's listening default. An optional spectrogram block gives the spectrogram and spectrum panels their own look, e.g. for VLF radio {"scale": "linear", "min_hz": 0, "max_hz": 16000, "bands": 240, "palette": "jet", "height": 1.4}: unfiltered bands independent of the analysed range (log or linear), the jet palette instead of the default, and a height factor (1–2). Every running copy opens its own connection to a stream's server, so add someone else's stream only with the operator's agreement.
